statement: Fix k ≥ 2, c > 0, and fixed packet bounds C0. There is a finite integer P0 such that, for every fixed P ≥ P0, there are a finite integer J0 and a constant C, depending only on k, c, C0, P and the packet conventions, with the following property. Let h ≥ 2, let V1, . . . , Vm be scale-h packet sums on one time interval of length at most C0h2, and suppose their normalized compact profiles have derivatives through order J0 bounded by C0. Let Ξi be their assigned frequency-label sets, with the fixed cap enlargements included. Assume bounded phase-space counting and det((2ξ1, 1), . . . , (2ξm, 1)) ≥ δ > 0 (ξi ∈ Ξi). Use P for the packet envelope exponent. Let Y be a set of distinct unit cubes and, for every Q ∈ Y and i, let zi,Q ∈ Q satisfy |Vi(zi,Q)| ≥ Ai ≥ hc , Bi(zi,Q)2 = X T s2 i,T wT (zi,Q) ≤ 1.
